text.content: Contigo GmbH's RAG pipeline is configured and the grounding instruction is in place. The compliance team has signed off on the system prompt. The development team is now in the final quality assurance phase before the agent goes into broader internal testing.

text.content: The QA engineer assigned to the retrieval evaluation raises a concern that the team has not yet addressed systematically. The retrieval pipeline has been tested with clean, precise queries. But Contigo's clients do not write queries like developers. They describe their situations in natural language, use informal phrasing, reference personal circumstances rather than policy categories, and sometimes ask questions that are semantically adjacent to the correct content without using any of its terminology.

text.content: The question the QA engineer is asking is not whether the pipeline works for ideal queries. It is whether the pipeline works for the queries real clients will actually send and what happens when it does not.

text.content: What retrieval evaluation measures

rich_text.plain_text: What retrieval evaluation measures

text.content: Evaluating a RAG pipeline requires separating two distinct quality dimensions that are easy to conflate.

rich_text.plain_text: Evaluating a RAG pipeline requires separating two distinct quality dimensions that are easy to conflate.

text.content: Retrieval quality:

rich_text.plain_text: Retrieval quality:

text.content: Measures whether the chunks returned by the vector database are relevant to the user's query. A retrieval failure occurs when the returned chunks do not contain the information needed to answer the question. Retrieval quality is evaluated before generation begins.

rich_text.plain_text: Measures whether the chunks returned by the vector database are relevant to the user's query. A retrieval failure occurs when the returned chunks do not contain the information needed to answer the question. Retrieval quality is evaluated before generation begins.

text.content: Generation quality:

rich_text.plain_text: Generation quality:

text.content: Measures whether the language model produced an accurate, grounded response from the chunks it received. A generation failure can occur even when retrieval succeeds.

rich_text.plain_text: Measures whether the language model produced an accurate, grounded response from the chunks it received. A generation failure can occur even when retrieval succeeds.

text.content: This lesson focuses exclusively on retrieval quality.

rich_text.plain_text: This lesson focuses exclusively on retrieval quality.

text.content: The two dimensions must be evaluated separately: Diagnosing a generation failure as a retrieval problem, or vice versa, leads to the wrong fix.

text.content: Contigo GmbH clients experiencing temporary payment difficulties may apply for a loan restructuring arrangement. text.content: Takeaway:

rich_text.plain_text: Takeaway:

text.content: Retrieval quality cannot be assumed from a working pipeline. It must be tested systematically across the range of phrasings real users will actually produce.

text.content: A system that retrieves correctly for developer-written queries but fails for client-written queries is not a reliable system. The gap between those two query styles is where most retrieval failures occur.
